{{Quote|Following the destruction of their homeworld, Nar Shadaa, by the Yuuzhan Vong, the Hutts have expanded into Cyax, including Da Soocha. Hutt interests there are overseen by our friend, Azzim Anjiliac Atirue.|[[Jhoram Bey]]|<ref name="Legacy 41" />}}
'''Azzim Anjiliac Atirue''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of [[Anjiliac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], who oversaw the Hutt business on [[Da Soocha]]. He also owned a high-end spa called [[Maya Armus]] on [[Napdu]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of Da Soocha, which utilized the water of the sacred planet's to aid in its relaxation. He wore a metal cap over his head. Azzim was also the nephew of [[Vedo Anjiliac Atirue]], the leader of Anjiliac kajidic and a member of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]].

==Biography==
In [[137 ABY]], Azzim helped the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] to smuggle offworld multiple [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] refugees fleeing from the Imperial [[Genocide on Dac|genocide]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], despite the risk to both himself and his business.

Later, the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[War Hammer]]'' [[Devastation of Da Soocha|bombarded]] Napdu, destroying the Hutt's spa and killing Azzim in the process under orders from [[Darth Azard]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rulf Yage]], who officially called the attack, felt terrible for his actions, but carried out the orders regardless. Yage knew that many innocents would be killed in the bombardment, and rebuked Azard's order to send clean-up crews to be overkill. The Moff attempted to picture Azzim's final moments, wondering as to what he thought as he died under tyranny. Azzim's death and its surrounding events greatly angered the Hutt Grand Council, and prompted them to action, albeit secretly, against the Empire.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The massacre of the Mon Calamari was disgraceful and personally disgusts me. But the Sith Imperials are not fools and some know the Mon Cals have taken shelter on Da Soocha before.|Azzim Anjiliac Atirue|<ref name="Legacy 41" />}}
Unlike many [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], Azzim was compassionate towards others and was disgusted by the purging of Dac, and allowed refugees from the planet to take shelter in his domain. Nevertheless, he was a businessman, and knew not to openly rebel against the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]]. Additionally, he would allow criminals to use his facilities, providing they had the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Azzim kept a security force of droids and personnel on hand to deal with any troublemakers.
